marketing_wrapper: Off-white #f9f8f4 backdrop (aubergine #2c2342 on 01) with a heavy condensed caption, sans subcaption, italic 'Available in select countries', and a flat cartoon-like phone outline (thick near-black stroke) showing ~50% UI. 01 is a hand holding a realistic phone. 05 is entirely marketing (floating 3D card renders). 02 crops the phone to the bottom half and replaces content with grey skeleton bars.

typography.display: Klarna Title: heavy condensed grotesk, very tight tracking, used in captions and in-app hero moments ('Get up to 10% cashback', '$500' balance)
typography.body: custom: Klarna Text (consistent with text record)
typography.numerals: condensed heavy for hero balance; regular-width bold for home balances; tabular unsure
typography.weights: Display black/heavy; row titles medium; subtitles regular grey
typography.case_and_tracking: Sentence case; tight negative tracking on the condensed display

accents: #ffa8cd (visual estimate, Klarna pink; not in palette.json top colours)
palette.accent_strategy: Pink is a brand token, not a data colour: logo badge, 'Plan a purchase' pill, K avatar, promo text. Interactive circles are pale lavender; amounts stay ink.
palette.source: palette.json 02 (#f3f2f6 20% UI tint), 04 (#fffefe 27%, #171227 22% ink and phone outline), 01 (#2c2342 42% aubergine backdrop and home header); pink and lavender visual

shape.radius_language: large and pill: radio cards ~16pt, card art ~16pt, home bottom sheet ~24pt with grabber, action circles, pill CTAs
shape.borders_shadows: Selected payment card gets a grey outline; soft shadow under the pink CTA overlapping the card; otherwise flat
shape.materials: Translucent search pill and circular buttons over the dark home header (01); otherwise flat

liquid_glass_visible: unclear: 01's search pill and round buttons over the aubergine header are translucent, but the photo is too small to confirm iOS 26 glass
density: medium; home packs two balances, four actions and four list rows above the fold
layout: Home: aubergine header with avatar, search pill, promo ('Get a Klarna membership'), and a white sheet with grabber holding Personal account and Purchase power side by side, four round actions, then list rows (Upgrade, Accounts & cards, Payments, Purchases & returns). Balance screen: K avatar, condensed hero balance, account-number chip, four round icon actions, Transactions.
navigation: Custom curved back arrow (↩ style) in nav bars; no tab bar visible; home uses a sheet-over-header structure
imagery_and_icons: Cut-out product photography (jacket, phone, nail polish, blender); outline custom icons; merchant icons in soft pastel circles
signature_visual_move: The account balance is set in Klarna's heavy condensed display face, the same face as the marketing headlines.
tells_present: Gestalt sameness: centred balance over a row of round icon action buttons

direction_fit.why: Owned pink and custom condensed display face confirmed; in the app the pink is restrained to tokens and one CTA, with the loud part carried by the condensed type and the aubergine header.

notes: MONEY ANATOMY. Hero balance '$500' in heavy condensed display, ~3x body, centred under a pink K avatar, no cents shown. Home balances '$500' and '$5,500' bold regular-width ~2x body, side by side under small labels with chevrons ('Personal account >', 'Purchase power >'). Cents not shown on any balance; $ full size. Debit '–$110' with minus, ink, not red; no credits shown. Tabular: unsure. No charts. Checkout/confirm: payment-method radio cards (Pay in full, Pay in 4, Pay in 30, Pay over time) with the selected card outlined and a filled radio, then a black full-width pill 'Pay with [pink Klarna badge]'; amounts in this flow are redacted to skeleton bars in the screenshot. List rows put money in subtitles ('$500 total balance', '$350 outstanding balance').
